usedFor: Livestorm holds the webinar events, sessions and registrants, and Instagram for Business posts the result with “Post Video or Reel”.

bestTemplate.name: “Event Published” in Livestorm, then “Post Video or Reel” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: When a webinar event is published, a video or Reel goes to your Instagram Business account.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” takes a photo or video from a public URL, so the media must be reachable at one.
